description: This file defines a JavaScript module for configuring and modifying CKEditor toolbars, including functions for toolbar group management, button handling, and configuration serialization.

classes.name: ToolbarConfigurator.ToolbarModifier
classes.description: A class for modifying CKEditor toolbar configurations, managing toolbar groups, buttons, and serialization.

methods.name: getActualConfig
methods.description: Returns the current toolbar configuration, parsing groups into config values.

methods.name: _onInit
methods.description: Initializes the toolbar modifier with given parameters.

methods.name: _showConfigurationTool
methods.description: Displays the configuration editing interface.

methods.name: _showConfig
methods.description: Generates and displays the current toolbar configuration code.

methods.name: _toggleVisibilityEmptyElements
methods.description: Toggles visibility of empty toolbar groups.

methods.name: _createModifier
methods.description: Creates the toolbar modifier UI and binds event handlers.

methods.name: showToolbarBtnsByGroupName
methods.description: Shows or hides toolbar buttons based on group name.

methods.name: parseGroupToConfigValue
methods.description: Converts a toolbar group object into its configuration string representation.

methods.name: getGroupOrSeparatorLiAncestor
methods.description: Finds the ancestor list item element for a group or separator.

methods.name: _setActiveElement
methods.description: Sets the currently active toolbar element.

methods.name: getActiveToolGroup
methods.description: Returns the currently active toolbar group.

methods.name: _dehighlightActiveToolGroup
methods.description: Removes highlight from the active toolbar group.

methods.name: _highlightGroup
methods.description: Highlights a specified toolbar group.

methods.name: getFirstEnabledButtonInGroup
methods.description: Returns the first enabled button in a group.

methods.name: getFirstEnabledButtonInSubgroup
methods.description: Returns the first enabled button in a subgroup.

methods.name: _handleCheckboxClicked
methods.description: Handles checkbox toggle for removing or adding buttons.

methods.name: _handleAnchorClicked
methods.description: Handles move, remove, or other actions triggered by button clicks.

methods.name: _refreshMoveBtnsAvalibility
methods.description: Enables or disables move buttons based on current state.

methods.name: _refreshBtnTabIndexes
methods.description: Updates tabindex attributes for toolbar buttons.

methods.name: _disableElementsInList
methods.description: Disables move buttons in a list based on visibility.

methods.name: getGroupIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a toolbar group by name.

methods.name: _addSeparator
methods.description: Adds a separator to the toolbar configuration.

methods.name: _removeSeparator
methods.description: Removes a separator from the toolbar configuration.

methods.name: _determineSeparatorToAddIndex
methods.description: Determines the index at which to add a new separator.

methods.name: _moveElement
methods.description: Moves a toolbar element up or down.

methods.name: _moveGroup
methods.description: Moves a toolbar group.

methods.name: _moveSubgroup
methods.description: Moves a subgroup within a toolbar group.

methods.name: _calculateTotalBtns
methods.description: Calculates total buttons in each group.

methods.name: _addButtonToRemoved
methods.description: Marks a button as removed.

methods.name: _removeButtonFromRemoved
methods.description: Unmarks a button as removed.

methods.name: createSeparatorLiteral
methods.description: Creates a separator object for configuration.

methods.name: _toolbarConfigToListString
methods.description: Serializes the toolbar configuration into an HTML string.

methods.name: _getToolbarSubgroupString
methods.description: Generates HTML for a subgroup.

methods.name: _getToolbarGroupString
methods.description: Generates HTML for a toolbar group.
